stories.title: Nationalbank zur Lex UBS – Wie kommt die scharfe Kritik der UBS bei Ihnen an, Herr Schlegel?

en.title: National Bank on Lex UBS – How does UBS's sharp criticism reach you, Mr. Schlegel?
en.summary: The National Bank president has responded calmly to criticism from UBS Chief Sergio Ermotti, dismissing the concerns raised.

stories.title: «Toucher aux effectifs a toujours un impact»: à Genève, le bras de fer budgétaire se joue aussi dans les classes

en.title: "Affecting staff always has an impact": in Geneva, the budget tug-of-war also plays out in classrooms
en.summary: Geneva's education sector faces cuts under a state budget savings plan announced last week, with unions opposing the measures while the education department claims service provision will not be reduced.

stories.title: Vegan mit Wow-Effekt – Noah Rechsteiner bringt den Garten auf den Gourmetteller

en.title: Vegan with wow factor – Noah Rechsteiner brings the garden to the gourmet plate
en.summary: Noah Rechsteiner started his own restaurant at 19 and had it listed in the Gault Millau guide seven years later.

stories.title: Wenn das Gedächtnis nachlässt – Die Stadt Zürich schult ihr Personal im Umgang mit Demenz

en.title: When memory fades – The City of Zurich trains its staff in dealing with dementia
en.summary: City of Zurich employees are participating in specialized courses to learn how to interact with dementia patients at public transport counters and tax offices.

stories.title: Nach mutmasslicher Gasexplosion in Athen: zwei Tote geborgen

en.title: After suspected gas explosion in Athens: two dead recovered
en.summary: Two bodies have been recovered following a house explosion and collapse in central Athens. Four people remain missing from the incident.

stories.title: Claire Simon fait réfléchir la jeunesse à travers l'œuvre d'Annie Ernaux dans un documentaire

en.title: Claire Simon explores youth reflection on Annie Ernaux's work in documentary
en.summary: Director Claire Simon's documentary examines how French students engage with author Annie Ernaux's literary works, exploring youth perspectives on love, abortion, and social class.

stories.title: Six ans après leur interdiction, les phtalates sont toujours présents en Suisse

en.title: Six years after ban, phthalates still present in Switzerland
en.summary: Testing of 200 suspicious items in Switzerland revealed that over half contained phthalates exceeding permitted limits, despite their prohibition six years ago. Product recalls have been issued to encourage stronger importer controls.

stories.title: A Pyongyang, le FC Missile terrasse le FC Economie II par 4 buts à 1

en.title: At Pyongyang, FC Missile defeats FC Economy II 4-1
en.summary: A sports chronicle reports on North Korean military production advances supported by combat experience in Ukraine and Moscow backing. North Korean weightlifter Ri Song-gum set three world records in her weight category at the Asian Games in Nagoya, Japan.

stories.title: La sacralisation de l’arbre, nouveau défi pour la densification urbaine en Suisse

en.title: The sacralization of trees, a new challenge for urban densification in Switzerland
en.summary: Swiss cities face tension between protecting existing tree canopy for climate reasons and building more housing in land-constrained areas. The debate centers on whether tree preservation rights should carry equal or greater weight than densification goals.

stories.title: Elternschaft unter Druck – Kinderarzt: «Kinder brauchen keine perfekten Eltern»

en.title: Parenthood under pressure – pediatrician: "Children don't need perfect parents"
en.summary: A pediatrician argues that perfectionism in child-rearing is harmful and that emotional warmth matters more than academic performance for children's wellbeing.

stories.title: Accueilli comme une rock star à Paris, le pape Léon XIV défie la France sur la fin de vie et la laïcité

en.title: Welcomed like a rock star in Paris, Pope Leo XIV challenges France on end-of-life issues and secularism
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV completed his first day in France at the Stade de France with approximately 80,000 young people. During his visit, the pontiff spoke against euthanasia and advocated for religion's role in public life.

stories.title: Après la liesse populaire et Notre-Dame, accueil de rock star au Stade de France pour Léon XIV

en.title: After popular celebrations and Notre-Dame, rock star welcome at the Stade de France for Leo XIV
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV concluded his first full day of pontifical visit to France with young people at the Stade de France. The day featured strong statements from the pope on societal matters following celebrations throughout Paris and at Notre-Dame.

stories.title: Verschärfung der Lex Koller: Schweizer Pensionskassen könnten Milliarden verlieren

en.title: Tightening of Lex Koller: Swiss pension funds could lose billions
en.summary: The National Council aims to restrict foreign investor access to the Swiss real estate market more severely, including real estate stocks and funds. The changes could significantly impact pension funds and private investors.

stories.title: Exklusive Daten zeigen: Die Klage über die Prämienlast ist übertrieben

en.title: Exclusive data show: Complaints about premium burden are exaggerated
en.summary: Swiss health insurance premiums rise annually, but new data indicate the financial burden remains manageable for households across all income levels.

stories.title: In der Schweiz ist Sprit doppelt so teuer wie in den USA oder Japan – das ist politisch so gewollt

en.title: Fuel in Switzerland costs twice as much as in the USA or Japan – this is politically intentional
en.summary: Swiss drivers pay among the world's highest prices for gasoline and diesel. High wage and infrastructure costs partially explain the difference, with political decisions also playing a role.

stories.title: Australien beschränkt Vergabe von Backpacker-Visa – auch Schweizer Zuwanderer sind betroffen

en.title: Australia restricts issuance of backpacker visas – Swiss migrants are also affected
en.summary: Australia's government has suspended visa applications from 23 countries, including Switzerland. The restrictions threaten labour shortages in hospitality, agriculture, and healthcare sectors.

stories.title: Wohlstand, ohne zu arbeiten: Elon Musk will die Vision von Karl Marx verwirklichen

en.title: Prosperity without work: Elon Musk wants to realize Karl Marx's vision
en.summary: The tech billionaire believes technological progress will soon create abundance for humanity, making the left-wing ideal of unconditional basic income a reality.
